routes: /settings/users (real UserAssignmentsPanel, reader state, RBACAPI, API client, grid, dialogs and shipped CSS with safe HTTP fixtures)
states: Eight cases per phase: Chromium desktop/light and phone/light/dark; WebKit phone/light. Playwright 1.56.1 matches all three integration lock packages; Chromium 141.0.7390.37, WebKit 26.0. Same fixtures, viewports, class themes and submitted actions in every before/final pair. All 26 final retained captures opened natively.

Fixture server applies a role reduction before dropping PUT response, or applies user removal before returning DELETE 502. Parent keeps the stale directory, role draft/saved permissions or removal confirmation and enabled repeat write. Final withdraws stale state, explicitly says change may already have applied and offers Check saved access. No premature No users state.

A failed saved-access read keeps the uncertainty, does not restore stale actions or show a false empty directory. An accepted user+role read shows the saved Reader role, or the accepted empty directory after removal. No horizontal overflow or unexpected browser errors.
interactions: Real client transmits existing expected-organisation header, exact selected role payload and one PUT/DELETE only per case. No automatic mutation retry or automatic post-failure read. Reconciliation uses GET only.

Keyboard Enter opens Manage Access. On unconfirmed completion the warning receives focus; Tab then Enter activates the saved-access check. Failed check keeps the warning and explicit retry. Successful check restores current data; reopened editor has exactly the saved role selection and Cancel dispatches no write.
Proof uses actual consuming modules with synthetic HTTP, not the complete App shell, a production-bundle render, backend authorization, IdP, original account, installed upgrade or release acceptance.
